PfDHFR.anchor: MTX catalytic-site copy A702 (33 atoms, centroid [-3.596, -5.249, -58.677])
PfDHFR.anchor_justification: Contact analysis: MTX A702 contacts canonical DHFR pocket residues Phe58/Phe116/Ile14/Ile164/Cys15/Asp54; B702 is the dimer mirror; A704 contacts surface residues only. Old V5 center (1.33, -1.733, -23.842) was the receptor centroid (35.5 A from A702).
PfDHFR.evidence: 17/17 polypharm pairs pass the composite Vina gate (job 12859): affinities -4.86 to -6.35 kcal/mol, pose-to-MTX-A702 minima 3.0-3.5 A, in-box fractions 0.944-1.0. CA frame PDB/PDBQT exact (rmsd 0).

PfCRT.anchor: Y01 (cholesterol hemisuccinate) A501 — membrane-mimetic PROXY, not an inhibitor
PfCRT.anchor_justification: Y01 is the only non-water HETATM; single instance A501. Per structural dossier PROXY_NOT_ACCEPTED: docked poses are valid relative to the Y01 cavity but are exploratory only, not potency claims.
PfCRT.evidence: 17/17 polypharm pairs pass the composite Vina gate (job 12855): affinities -5.12 to -7.91 kcal/mol, pose-to-Y01 minima 3.0-4.1 A, in-box fractions 1.0.

PfClpP.anchor_justification: 4GM2 is PfClpR (inactive paralog), NOT PfClpP — replaced by genuine PfClpP 2F6I (EC 3.4.21.92, UniProt O97252; active-site Ser289 = 2F6I Ser252, offset 37). Triad geometrically complete in all 7 chains; old V5 center was the barrel-channel centroid (22 A from nearest triad).
PfClpP.evidence: 17/17 polypharm pairs pass the composite Vina gate (job 12854): affinities -5.05 to -7.03 kcal/mol, pose-to-triad minima 3.3-8.9 A, in-box fractions 0.963-1.0.

PfATP4.anchor_justification: No co-crystallized small-molecule anchor (protein-partner PfABP only); CAVITY_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED. Excluded from the primary three-target V5 claim unless independently supported cavity evidence is provided.
